include.description: Globs relative to the project root.

contains.description: Regex (multiline) the file content must match, e.g. `#\[test\]`.

inline.description: Matched files are production code with embedded tests: never deleted as a whole.

matchers.description: A file belongs to the language if any matcher accepts it.

caseStart.description: Regex matching the line where a test case starts. Without it the agent finds cases alone and files are never deleted as a whole.

attribute.description: Regex for decorator/attribute lines that belong to the case below them (`@pytest.mark...`, `#[ignore]`).

blockComments.description: Blank `/* ... */` comments before scanning, so commented-out tests are not detected.

blocks.description: How a case's last line is found: balanced `()`/`{}`, or indentation (Python). Unset: the agent reports it.

languages.description: Replaces the default languages. Prefer `extraLanguages` to add one.

attribute.description: Regex for decorator/attribute lines that belong to the case below them (`@pytest.mark...`, `#[ignore]`).

blocks.description: How a case's last line is found: balanced `()`/`{}`, or indentation (Python). Unset: the agent reports it.

extraLanguages.description: Languages checked before the defaults (the first matching language wins).

include.description: Only files matching one of these globs are considered.

exclude.description: Added to the default excludes (node_modules, dist, build, target, virtual environments, ...).

budget.description: Target tokens of test code per group.

minGroup.description: Groups smaller than this are merged with neighbors when possible.

tolerance.description: Allowed overshoot over `budget`, as a fraction.

outDir.description: Directory for state, sessions and reports, relative to the root.

model.description: Model pattern resolved through your pi config, e.g. `claude-haiku-5-5` or `provider/id:low`.

concurrency.description: Maximum parallel agents; never more than there are groups.

instructions.description: Markdown file with repository-specific rules appended to the rubric, relative to the root.

maxRejections.description: Rejected `submit_file_report` calls tolerated per file before it is marked failed.

maxIdleTurns.description: Model turns without an accepted report before the group's session is aborted.

agentDir.description: pi config directory for the pool (settings, auth, models, packages). Default: pi's own.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers for the pool only, in pi's `mcp.json` format (`command`/`args` or `url`). Exposure defaults to `direct`; their tools still need to be listed in `tools`.

tools.description: Extra tool names or patterns the agents may call, e.g. `mcp__serena__find_symbol`.

extensions.description: Extra pi extension files loaded in every agent session.

trustProject.description: Load the audited project's `.pi` settings, packages and extensions.

title: tests-diet config
description: Settings for tests-diet, read from tests-diet.config.json at the project root. CLI flags win.
